Dear Jurimesh Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content & Growth Marketer position at Jurimesh. Your mission to shape the legal tech category deeply resonates with my drive to build measurable organic growth and my background in SEO, content, and web development.

My experience at Knowledge Experts and Episto has equipped me with hands-on skills in managing content engines, technical SEO, and building inbound machines, including WordPress site design, content writing, and analytics. I am particularly adept at leveraging AI tools for content and audits, and my technical background allows me to approach marketing with a unique, automation-driven perspective.

I am fluent in English and possess Dutch proficiency (B1 writing), which I believe would be valuable in your home market. The prospect of taking ownership and pioneering your marketing strategy in a fast-paced startup environment is very exciting.

Thank you for your time and consideration. My CV is attached for your review.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Jurimesh Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Content & Growth Marketer position at Jurimesh. Your mission to define the future of AI in legal due diligence, coupled with a fast-paced, ownership-driven startup culture, perfectly aligns with my career aspirations and proven ability to build and optimize digital growth strategies.

My experience as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts and Junior Digital Marketer at Episto has provided me with a robust foundation in owning content engines and building inbound machines. I've successfully driven organic traffic through comprehensive keyword research, on-page SEO, and meticulous content management for various client websites. A notable achievement includes optimizing mirook.com, where I implemented advanced JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and technical SEO audits that measurably enhanced its search health and AI search visibility.

What differentiates my approach is a blend of marketing acumen with a strong technical background. I am highly comfortable using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily for research, content generation, and audits, along with prompt engineering and integrating AI agents for efficiency. My skills extend to Python scripting for automation and web development, enabling me to find innovative angles and streamline processes beyond conventional marketing methods. This technical edge allows me to craft unique, defensible content strategies that can truly distinguish Jurimesh.

I thrive in environments where autonomy and continuous learning are paramount. I am eager to apply my range of skills – from writing compelling blog posts to analyzing performance – and immerse myself in the intricate world of M&A lawyers and PE investors. My fluency in English, alongside B1 proficiency in Dutch, will facilitate effective communication and content localization within your key markets.

The opportunity to be the first marketing hire, directly shaping Jurimesh’s perception and growth, is incredibly appealing. I am confident my strategic approach, technical capabilities, and drive for measurable results will significantly contribute to increasing qualified inbound and elevating Jurimesh’s awareness.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Jurimesh's continued success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Approximately two years of dedicated marketing and SEO experience as a Web & SEO Specialist and Junior Digital Marketer, including B2B client work.
- Proven expertise in content writing, on-page SEO, keyword research, and WordPress website management, with a track record of growing organic traffic for client sites.
- Strong technical proficiency in AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT for research/content/audits, prompt engineering, AI agents) and coding skills (Python, HTML/CSS/JS) for marketing automation.
- Successfully implemented advanced SEO strategies, including JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup, and AEO/llms.txt for AI search visibility, demonstrating measurable improvements for mirook.com.
- Fluent in English with B1 Dutch writing skills, complementing the market focus, and holding certifications in SEO Fundamentals, GA4, Google Ads, and Content Marketing.
